facts.business: Tarini International Limited is an infrastructure company with investments in subsidiaries across infrastructure, sugars, distilleries, energy, mining, and lifesciences sectors.

auditor.name: M. MODI & ASSOCIATES
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion on investment of Rs.121.59 Lakhs in subsidiary with recurring losses and net capital deficiency; Emphasis of matters on trade receivables/payables confirmations not obtained, provisional attachment of farm house by ED, Supreme Court appeal against SAT penalty of Rs.505 Lakhs, and ROC complaints dismissed.

key_risks: Investment in subsidiary with recurring losses and net capital deficiency (Rs.121.59 Lakhs) raising going concern doubt
Provisional attachment of farm house by Enforcement Directorate under PMLA
Supreme Court appeal against SAT penalty of Rs.505 Lakhs
Trade receivables and payables without external confirmations
ROC complaints filed (seven dismissed in favor)
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions approved with 10 related parties including subsidiaries (Tarini Infrastructure Limited, Tarini Sugars and Distillaries Limited, Venture Infrastructure Limited, B. Soilmec India Private Limited, Yatih Air Services Private Limited, Tarini Wilderness Innovations Private Limited, Tarini Lifesciences Limited, Venture Energy and Technologies Limited, Tarini Overseas Mining and Operations Limited, Tarini Humanitarian Demining and Rehabilitation Works) and associates/group companies.
